title: Hr Executive And Generalist
description:
The HR Executive will be responsible for managing and establishing HR operations within a stock broking firm. The role involves recruitment, employee management, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee engagement and development of HR policies and procedures. The candidate should have an understanding of financial services recruitment, capital market hiring and the performance-driven culture of the stock broking industry. 
 Key Responsibilities :- 
 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Handle end-to-end recruitment for Relationship Managers, Dealers, Sales Executives, Compliance Officers and Back-office staff. Source candidates with NISM certifications and capital market experience wherever required. Manage job postings, resume screening, interviews and offer rollouts. Coordinate with business heads for recruitment requirements. Conduct background verification, particularly for finance-related roles. 
 2. Onboarding & Documentation Manage employee onboarding, induction and joining formalities. Maintain employee records, KYC documents and required regulatory documentation. Coordinate employee documentation with the Compliance Department. Handle employee confirmation, transfers and exit formalities. 
 3. HR Operations & Administration Establish HR processes, policies and procedures from scratch. Manage attendance, leave records and employee databases. Develop leave policies, attendance policies and employee code of conduct. Maintain organisational charts and employee reporting structures. 
 4. Payroll & Incentive Management Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the Accounts Department. Manage salary structures, incentives and performance-linked payouts. Maintain attendance, leave and statutory deduction records. Coordinate PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and other applicable statutory requirements. 
 5. Employee Relations & Engagement Address employee queries and grievances. Maintain a professional and positive work environment. Implement employee engagement and retention initiatives. Handle disciplinary matters in coordination with management. 
 6. Performance Management Assist in setting KPIs for sales executives, relationship managers and dealers. Coordinate performance appraisal cycles. Monitor employee performance and maintain appraisal records. Support management in performance improvement and employee retention. 
 7. Compliance & Regulatory Coordination Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and internal HR policies. Maintain employee documentation required for regulatory audits. Coordinate with the Compliance Department for SEBI and exchange-related employee requirements. Maintain confidentiality of employee and client-sensitive information.

title: Growth & Community Executive Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Videos@AI is India’s AI video marketplace, connecting brands and businesses with verified AI video creators for a wide range of marketing and creative needs. The platform helps businesses easily discover creators, post video projects, compare proposals, and manage communication and deliveries in one place. Companies can source AI-powered ads, Reels and Shorts, product films, explainers, animation, music videos, and more from specialized AI video creators. Creators use Videos@AI to showcase portfolios, submit proposals, build reputations through reviews, and grow their freelance businesses under a 0% commission model. Built on specialisation, transparency, and opportunity, Videos@AI makes AI video talent more accessible while ensuring a reliable marketplace for both brands and creators.
  
**Role Description**
The Growth & Community Executive Intern role is a remote internship focused on supporting platform growth and nurturing the creator and brand community at Videos@AI. In this role, the intern will assist with identifying and reaching out to potential creators and brands, supporting onboarding, and engaging users through regular communication across social platforms, email, and community channels. The intern will help track and analyze user behavior, campaign performance, and marketplace activity to suggest improvements for growth initiatives. Day-to-day tasks include supporting sales outreach, coordinating with creators and brands on project-related queries, maintaining community resources, and contributing to experiments that improve user engagement and retention. The intern will collaborate closely with the founding and growth teams, gaining exposure to marketplace operations, AI video trends, and startup processes.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret user data, campaign performance, and growth metrics.
* Effective communication skills for engaging with creators, brands, and internal teams.
* Interest or experience in growth hacking and digital experimentation to support user acquisition and retention.
* Basic understanding of sales outreach and relationship-building with potential partners.
* Project management skills to coordinate tasks, follow up on action items, and meet deadlines.
* Comfort working in a remote, fast-paced startup environment with a proactive and self-driven mindset.
* Familiarity with online marketplaces, creator ecosystems, or digital media is an advantage.
